NOTE: the HIGH-2 regression fixture. Byte-for-byte the wedge of dump-wedged.txt, with
one difference: the RPC pool is pool-2, not pool-1. That is not hypothetical — the
JDK's DefaultThreadFactory numbers pools from a PROCESS-GLOBAL counter, so any
library that creates a pool before RpcServer does shifts every RPC thread's name by
one. It is pool-1 today by coincidence alone.

KILLS: anchoring the fallback to the literal `pool-1-thread-`. That predicate counts
0 here and logs "not restarting" through a genuine permanent deadlock — reproduced
end to end against a real JVM.
